answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The ivory holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
